rule: Speech: each creature group is a weighted set of lines; a pick is weighted-random among lines this creature instance has not said in that group; when all are used, the memory clears. Per-group options: trigger chance rolled per attempt, cooldown (ms stored, rounded up to seconds) and player-only gate. Gossip: up to 8 weighted variants per text id; the server sends all weights and the client picks. Signs: a text object points at a first page; pages link by NextPage; the server returns the whole chain in one reply; interaction distance 5.5555553 yards. Faction relations: same faction friendly, then explicit enemy and friend lists (up to 4 each), then group bitmasks, with a hates-all-except-friends flag at runtime. Pet names: first half plus second half from per-family pools, with the family name as fallback.
